reserves.name: Mexican-peso fiat deposits in a Mexican bank account

sources.label: Independent public accountant certification for wMXN - March 2026

reserveReview.rationale: The March 31, 2026 certification reconciles 518,689 outstanding wMXN across six chains and MXN937,364.13 of collateral to a Mexican bank statement, then certifies that all outstanding tokens are backed by Mexican pesos at a financial institution in Mexico. The engagement is expressly a certification, not an audit or review, and the bank and account terms are not disclosed. Write-time re-open 2026-08-08: the CPA certification PDF still states 100% local-currency bank-deposit collateral, and Ripio's current local-stablecoins and wFIAT pages still identify wMXN as a peso-backed wFIAT product. No later reserve breakdown or named bank was disclosed, so the single 100% bank-deposit slice preserves the documented unknowns.
reserveReview.compositionBasis: Independent public accountant certification of the wMXN collateral as of March 31, 2026
reserveReview.knownUnknownExposure: No reserve asset class is unclassified; the Mexican financial institution, account type, and withdrawal liquidity are undisclosed.

custodyProfile.uncertainty: The March 31, 2026 certification by Pablo Eduardo Soto (Certified Public Accountant, Professional Council of Economic Sciences of CABA) reconciled 518,689 outstanding wMXN to MXN 937,364.13 on a Mexican bank statement but is expressly not an audit or review — it is an agreed-procedures certification on client-supplied documents, and it is the first wMXN attestation published. The bank is not named; account segregation, insolvency protections, and rehypothecation terms are undisclosed, and the certified collateral-to-token surplus (~1.81x) is unexplained in the document.
